WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(trim('{{ $json.run_ids ?? '' }}'), '') AS run_ids_raw,
    CASE
      WHEN trim(coalesce('{{ $json.per_batch ?? '' }}', '')) = '' THEN 5
      WHEN lower(trim('{{ $json.per_batch ?? '' }}')) IN ('all','tümü','tum','hepsi','tümünü') THEN 2147483647
      ELSE trim('{{ $json.per_batch ?? '' }}')::int
    END AS cap
),
cs_input AS (
  SELECT trim(x) AS name
  FROM unnest(regexp_split_to_array(trim('{{ $json.caresites ?? '' }}'), '[[:space:],]+')) AS x
  WHERE trim(x) <> ''
),
cs_set AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cs.uniqueref FROM care_site cs JOIN cs_input i
    ON cs.care_site_source_value ILIKE i.name OR cs.care_site_name ILIKE '%' || i.name || '%'
),
cs_flag AS (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cs_input) = 0 AS no_filter),
run_arr AS (
  SELECT array(SELECT trim(x) FROM unnest(regexp_split_to_array(coalesce((SELECT run_ids_raw FROM input),''), '[[:space:],]+')) AS x WHERE trim(x) <> '') AS runs
),
-- run filtresi: elle run listesi verildiyse SADECE o runlar; verilmediyse son 14 gunde tamamlanmis cevrim
batch_done AS (
  SELECT r.run_id, rd.sample_project, COUNT(DISTINCT rd.uniqueref) AS done_cnt
  FROM reads rd
  JOIN conversions c ON c.uniqueref = rd.conversion_ref
  JOIN runs r        ON r.uniqueref = c.run_ref
  JOIN data_operations dop ON dop.read_ref = rd.uniqueref
      AND dop.recipe_ref IN (SELECT uniqueref FROM data_operation_recipes WHERE platform_concept_ref = 549 AND kit_ref IS NOT NULL)
      AND dop.status_concept_ref IN (24, 26, 27, 29)
  WHERE rd.kit_ref IN (SELECT kit_ref FROM data_operation_recipes WHERE platform_concept_ref = 549 AND kit_ref IS NOT NULL)
    AND (CASE WHEN (SELECT run_ids_raw FROM input) IS NULL
              THEN (c.status_concept_ref = 29 AND c.conversion_time >= now() - interval '14 days')
              ELSE r.run_id IN (SELECT unnest(runs) FROM run_arr) END)
    AND ((SELECT no_filter FROM cs_flag) OR rd.requesting_caresite_ref IN (SELECT uniqueref FROM cs_set))
  GROUP BY r.run_id, rd.sample_project
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT rd.uniqueref AS read_ref, rd.sample_project, r.run_id, rd.kit_ref,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.run_id, rd.sample_project ORDER BY random()) AS rn
  FROM reads rd
  JOIN conversions c ON c.uniqueref = rd.conversion_ref
  JOIN runs r        ON r.uniqueref = c.run_ref
  WHERE rd.kit_ref IN (SELECT kit_ref FROM data_operation_recipes WHERE platform_concept_ref = 549 AND kit_ref IS NOT NULL)
    AND (CASE WHEN (SELECT run_ids_raw FROM input) IS NULL
              THEN (c.status_concept_ref = 29 AND c.conversion_time >= now() - interval '14 days')
              ELSE r.run_id IN (SELECT unnest(runs) FROM run_arr) END)
    AND ((SELECT no_filter FROM cs_flag) OR rd.requesting_caresite_ref IN (SELECT uniqueref FROM cs_set))
    -- Bos/basarisiz ornekleri ele: sayisi DOLU ve 1000'den az ise QC'ye sokma (NULL=sayilmamis, dokunma)
    AND (rd.reads IS NULL OR rd.reads >= 1000)
    -- Zaten herhangi bir QC kaydi (basarisiz dahil) olani tekrar acma
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM data_operations dop WHERE dop.read_ref = rd.uniqueref
                      AND dop.recipe_ref IN (SELECT uniqueref FROM data_operation_recipes WHERE platform_concept_ref = 549 AND kit_ref IS NOT NULL)
                      AND dop.status_concept_ref IN (24, 26, 27, 29))
)
INSERT INTO data_operations (read_ref, recipe_ref, status_concept_ref, batch_source_value)
SELECT e.read_ref, rp.uniqueref, 24, e.sample_project
FROM eligible e
JOIN data_operation_recipes rp ON rp.kit_ref = e.kit_ref AND rp.platform_concept_ref = 549
LEFT JOIN batch_done bd ON bd.run_id = e.run_id AND bd.sample_project = e.sample_project
WHERE e.rn <= ((SELECT cap FROM input) - COALESCE(bd.done_cnt, 0))
RETURNING uniqueref, read_ref, batch_source_value;
